name: One-goal marketing plan builder
why: Turns a vague result into a number with a date, works back to the volumes needed and schedules tests with stop dates, like the goal-to-growth-model prompt.

name: Traction channel test picker
why: Ranks channels and picks the tests to run first, the Bullseye step the growth leads run from the Traction pack.

name: Growth idea ranker
why: Scores ideas for impact, confidence and ease and picks the first three to test, as in the growth-experiment-design skill.

name: Product-market fit checker
why: Looks for signs that customers pull rather than you push, before any growth spend.

name: Cohort funnel reader
why: Reads results by join week or month and flags groups too small to trust, the core of the funnel-and-retention-diagnosis skill.

name: Input metric picker
why: Finds the controllable inputs behind each output metric, for a short weekly scoreboard.

name: CAC payback checker
why: Checks CAC against gross profit over 30, 90 and 180 days and sets target, ceiling and floor CAC, matching the unit-economics-and-cac-limit skill.

name: Set your CAC limit and test what ads add
why: Pairs a CAC limit with a test of what ads really added, the incrementality step in the measurement skill.

name: A/B test traffic checker
why: Sizes a fair test from your traffic and says how many weeks it needs, or that it is not feasible.

name: Experiment readout desk
why: Checks a test plan before launch and gives a verdict with confidence after, for the weekly growth review.

name: Channel decay checker
why: Finds where a channel began to fade and tests likely causes, the Law of Shitty Clickthroughs in practice.

name: Weekly product funnel watcher
why: Reads the funnel and each sign-up week every Monday and tells a real move from a normal swing.

name: Subscription churn watcher
why: Shows where subscribers leave each month and whether last month's fix worked, for retention work.

name: Monthly channel budget reviewer
why: Sets what each ad platform claims against what the store really took, as in the attribution reconciliation prompt.

name: Interview customers and map what they hire you to do
why: Runs customer interviews and maps the job buyers hire you for, before choosing a first segment.
